title: Zoom - Service Degradation Affecting Apple Login for Zoom Sign-in.
text:
Service: Zoom
Incident: Service Degradation Affecting Apple Login for Zoom Sign-in.
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-09-21T11:17:47.074-07:00
Resolved: 2026-09-22T10:57:12.699-07:00
Updates:
- 2026-09-22T10:57:12.699-07:00: resolved - This incident has been resolved and the affected services have been restored.
- 2026-09-21T18:35:19.237-07:00: monitoring - The issue affecting a subset of users with Apple Login for Zoom Sign-in has been successfully resolved. 

Our team will continue to monitor the situation closely and keep you informed of any further developments.
- 2026-09-21T18:32:37.434-07:00: identified - We have identified the service degradation affecting a subset of users with Apple Login for Zoom Sign-in.

Our team is actively working on a resolution, and we will keep you informed with timely updates as progress is made. 

Thank you for your patience.
- 2026-09-21T11:17:47.207-07:00: investigating - We are currently investigating a service degradation affecting a subset of users with Apple Login for Zoom Sign-in.

Our team is actively working to identify the impact and root cause. We will provide an update as soon as more information becomes available.

We appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this issue.
